awards.display_name: PURPOSE: THE PURPOSE OF THIS GRANT IS TO ENABLE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT OF HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE PLATFORM TO CHARACTERIZE THE MICROSTRUCTURE AND DEFECTS OF METAL ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING (AM) PARTS IN REAL TIME USING ULTRASOUND NON-DESTRUCTIVE EVALUATION (NDE).ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: AN ULTRASOUND NDE SYSTEM INTEGRATED WITH LASER POWDER BED FUSION AM MACHINE WILL ENABLE THE ACQUISITION OF ULTRASOUND RESPONSES AND EDGE COMPUTING FOR DATA ANALYSIS IN REAL-TIME. A COMPREHENSIVE KNOWLEDGE BASE USING MACHINE LEARNING WILL QUANTITIVELY BRIDGE THE ULTRASOUND RESPONSES TO MICROSTRUCTURES AND DEFECTS. PHYSICS-BASED COMPUTATIONAL MODELS FOR SOLIDIFICATION MICROSTRUCTURES AND ULTRASOUND PROPAGATION WILL ESTABLISH A THEORETICAL BASELINE AND A FUNDAMENTAL UNDERSTANDING OF ULTRASOUND RESPONSES. A DATA SCIENCE TOOL TO DEPLOY THE MODELS FROM THE KNOWLEDGE BASE ONTO REAL-TIME COMPUTING SYSTEMS WILL ENABLE THE TIMING DETERMINISTIC IN SITU CHARACTERIZATION OF MICROSTRUCTURE.EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THE COMPLETION OF THIS PROJECT WILL DELIVER AN ULTRASOUND NDE TOOL SPECIFICALLY FOR QUALIFYING AM PARTS AND BUILD A FOUNDATION TO BRIDGE THE GAP BETWEEN EX SITU MEASUREMENT AND ONLINE, REAL-TIME MICROSTRUCTURE AND DEFECTS CHARACTERIZATION DURING LASER POWDER BED FUSION AM.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: THE ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING AND NON-DESTRUCTIVE EVALUATION COMMUNITIES WILL BENEFIT FROM INSIGHTS INTO HOW MICROSTRUCTURES AT DIFFERENT LENGTH SCALES INTERACT WITH ULTRASOUND AT VARIOUS FREQUENCIES AND AMPLITUDES, PROVIDING A REAL-TIME MONITORING SOLUTION BASED ON PHYSICAL PRINCIPLES TO UNCOVER MICROSTRUCTURAL CHARACTERISTICS.  FUNDS FROM THIS GRANT WILL BE USED TO EMPLOY GRADUATE STUDENTS, WHO WILL BENEFIT BY GAINING EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE IN ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING, A GROWING ADVANCED MANUFACTURING PROCESS.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: UNIVERSITY OF SOUTH CAROLINA INTENDS TO SUBCONTRACT WITH UNIVERSITY OF ILLINOIS AT URBANA-CHAMPAIGN AND AUBURN UNIVERSITY.  THESE UNIVERSITIES WILL DEVELOP A HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE PLATFORM THAT CHARACTERIZES THE MICROSTRUCTURE AND DEFECTS OF METALLIC PARTS IN REAL-TIME USING ULTRASOUND NON-DESTRUCTIVE EVALUATION (NDE) IN THE LASER POWDER BED FUSION AM (LPBFAM) PROCESS.
